interactions.note: The epitope specific mAb 8C11 bound to the immobilized capsid protein E2, the truncated protein E2s and p239 virus-like particles (VLP) composed of the capsid protein in a direct ELISA. E2s forms a dimer and E2 forms a hexamer. In a sandwich ELISA, with mAb 8C11 as the capture and detection Ab, p239 but not E2s was recognized. MAb 8C11 also bound to the recombinant VLP based vaccine Helicon in a sandwich ELISA.
The epitope specific mAb 8C11 detected the virus in feces samples from genotype1 HEV-infected rhesus.

interactions.assay: surface plasmon resonance (SPR) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The affinity of the epitope specific mAb 8C11 IgG for binding to the capsid protein E2 was determined by surface plasmon resonance as described in the cited reference: Zhang et al. (2005) Vaccine 23(22): 2881-2892 [PMID: 15780737]. The affinity of 8C11 Fab was KD = 600 nM.

The epitope-specific 8C11 mAb bound to the HEV E2s(I) domain on western blots, ELISA and by sedimentation velocity analysis. Mutation R512A (or R512 substitution with E,L, K, H or Y) or mutation S497T (or S497 substitution with E,L, K, H or Y) in E2 abolished binding of 8C11 on western blots and in sedimentation velocity experiments.
